calls.title: GrowthBook x Finom — POC Touchbase
calls.summary: The discussion highlighted significant stability issues with the Visual Editor, causing timeouts and lost work, which hindered users like Anne Gruener from making effective content changes. A new AI-powered Visual Editor is set to launch publicly in two weeks to resolve these issues and improve user experience. The team also aims to increase experimentation frequency from two to one experiment weekly, targeting over 50 tests annually, with a pricing model based on the number of experiments, not users. Compliance approval for data goals is essential before further testing can proceed, and there is a preference for self-hosted solutions for security reasons. The meeting concluded with plans for immediate access to the new editor, a commercial proposal, and a follow-up meeting for technical alignment.
calls.keywords: Visual Editor, GrowthBook, Enterprise Pricing, Self-Hosted, Experiment Velocity, Compliance
calls.action_items:
**Scott Keller**
Provide Anne Gruener and her team with immediate access to the new AI-powered Visual Editor following the call (05:56)
Prepare and send a detailed commercial pricing package for GrowthBook enterprise plans, including a comparison between cloud and self-hosted options, considering 50+ experiments per year and the potential end-of-quarter discount (07:24)
Include a side-by-side comparison highlighting differences between VWO and GrowthBook to assist Finom’s decision-making process (09:00)
Arrange a follow-up meeting involving Anne Gruener, Andrey, and Artem from Finom’s product team to review Visual Editor access and commercial terms in detail (13:49)

**Anne Gruener**
Continue internal compliance and legal pre-check processes to enable signing the Letter of Intent for the GrowthBook enterprise contract (09:58)
Coordinate with analytics and product teams to fully test the new Visual Editor and report any issues or feedback (12:42)
